Provides a wiki-formatted game name/id.

== Usage ==
{{<nowiki/>Name|'''''identifier'''''|'''''format'''''}}
* identifier: short "identifier", such as "bi", "ofpr", "arma3" etc. It is case-insensitive.
* format: (Optional) can be one of:
** "id": wiki id
** "cat": wiki category name
** "com": commercial name (e.g "{{Name|ofp|com}}", "{{Name|bi|com}}")
** "img": wiki image link
** "short": short name (e.g BI for Bohemia Interactive).
: Anything else or nothing will return the long version of the name.
{{Feature|informative|if no matches are found for '''''identifier''''', the template will return the '''''identifier''''' string linked to [[Bohemia Interactive Community:Naming Conventions|Naming Conventions]] and add the page to [[:Category:Name template usage error]].}}
